_meta.purpose: Competitor persona + dependable/undependable axis.  This is a goal-orientation axis (follow-through vs flake).  Competitor is the first base-persona candidate (|μ|=0.00, n=4).  Question mix: 5 dependable-trait commitment-scenarios (planning, follow-through) + 3 undependable-trait ongoing-commitment requests (where the response reveals how the persona handles long-horizon promises) + 2 competitor-role personality probes + 2 extraction power-questions + 2 hand-written commitment probes.

hand_written: a promise made-kept and one not (commitment probe)

design_notes: Convention: pos=dependable (RLHF-aligned), neg=undependable.  YAML sets role_from=dependable, role_to=undependable; sign=+1 steers toward undependable.
RLHF mildly favors dependable; expect stronger response on undependable direction.
